title: Answer: most intelligent activity goes on without self-conscious awareness

statements.text: The view has no separate theory of intelligence. It holds that much intelligent and sentient activity, perhaps most, goes on without self-conscious awareness, as subliminal effects, blindsight and confabulation show, and that brains are the best information processors there are to study.

sources.quote: a great deal of intelligent and sentient activity, perhaps the lion’s share, goes on without benefit of self-conscious awareness
